item.title: Kaak '29: The SciLi's one redeeming quality was its hours - now it's just ugly
item.description: Late nights at the Sciences Library used to be a central part of my routine. It is simply my nature to stay up late, very late. Last month, however, the University quietly announced that the SciLi would no longer operate with 24-hour access on weekdays. item.title: Rhode Island Foundation granted record-breaking $93 million to nonprofits in 2025
item.description: In 2025, a year when federal funding cuts and rising costs strained nonprofits across Rhode Island, the Rhode Island Foundation distributed $93 million in grants. Many of the grants, which were publicly announced two weeks ago, went toward supporting health care, food services and housing across the state.Founded in 1916, the Rhode Island Foundation is the state's only community foundation and one of the oldest of its kind in the United States.
